title: Balram v. State of U.P. And 3 Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Shekhar B. Saraf, J.; Kshitij Shailendra, J.
disposition: Writ disposed of; petitioner directed to file Clause 6.5 objection, to be decided in six weeks.
headnote: Writ disposed of without merits adjudication. Petitioner directed to file an application/objection under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 within two weeks; the concerned authority shall decide it within six weeks of filing after hearing the petitioner.
facts: Balram filed a writ petition in the Allahabad High Court against the State of Uttar Pradesh and three others. Counsel for the petitioner and counsel for respondents 2 to 4 (the distribution licensee) were heard. The order does not record the underlying billing or supply grievance. The Court did not decide that dispute on merits and instead confined itself to a direction that the petitioner pursue the statutory application/objection under Clause 6.5 of the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

holding_units.holding: A writ petitioner may be directed to file an application/objection under Clause 6.5 of the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, 2005; if filed within two weeks, the concerned authority shall decide it within six weeks of filing after granting an opportunity of hearing. The writ is disposed of without a merits grant or refusal.

not_decided.point: Merits of the petitioner's electricity grievance
not_decided.note: The Court did not examine the underlying supply or billing dispute and relegated the petitioner to Clause 6.5.
